patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with high-contrast background colors or dynamic graphics create strong visual separation and impact, often featuring a single dominant element.
Uses extremely oversized, condensed sans-serif typography as primary graphic elements, filling entire sections with single words or short phrases for dramatic effect.
A bold, high-contrast color palette featuring stark black and white, vibrant red, deep blue, and unexpected accents like bright yellow and purple.
The initial hero section features a dynamic, interactive network graphic that appears to parallax or shift horizontally as the user scrolls, revealing a fixed-width content card alongside it.
Content sections below the hero are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a guided scroll experience.
Client logos are presented in a simple, clean grid on a black background, maintaining the high-contrast aesthetic.

technique_notes: A sticky header navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to site links.
The hero section utilizes a canvas-based or video background animation (detected as video-hero) that responds to scroll, creating a parallax or horizontal reveal effect for foreground content cards.
Subsequent content sections are animated into view using scroll-triggered reveals, where elements like large text blocks or images fade and slide up as they become visible in the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, condensed sans-serif headings (up to ~8x body text) create a bold, graphic statement, contrasted with smaller, legible sans-serif for navigation and body text.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, especially in hero and large text sections, creating dramatic negative space; tighter in client logo grids.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its audacious use of typography as a primary graphic element, featuring words that span entire screens in massive, condensed fonts. The dynamic, interactive hero background and the unexpected, playful piano keyboard at the bottom add a memorable, artistic flair that elevates it beyond a standard portfolio site into a digital art piece.
